name: Ridd
notes: commissioner, dive radio host, football in hands, sporty coach jacket
title: Design Leader
bio: Runs Dive, hosts Dive Radio, and is building Inflight. Thinks best with a football in his hands — the good ideas arrive mid-toss.

name: Tommy Geoco
notes: lorekeeper with load-bearing mustache, documentarian, green overshirt as luigi nod
title: Design Leader
bio: Films other people’s design teams for a living, burns AI tokens like spell slots, and DMs on weekends. The mustache is load-bearing. Roll initiative.

name: Rauno Freiberg
notes: the detailer, vercel designer, obsessive micro-craft, sharp speedy fox energy
title: Product Designer
bio: Designer at Vercel and author of Devouring Details, an obsessive catalogue of interface micro-craft that has quietly become required reading. Estonian, and unusually serious about the things most people never notice.

name: Pablo Stanley
notes: the illustrator, humaaans style modular character, playful pink-friendly outfit
title: Product Designer
bio: Drew Humaaans and Open Peeps, the modular illustration libraries that ended up in half the startup landing pages on the internet. Now designs and codes on v0 at Vercel, having co-founded Blush and Lummi along the way.

name: Julie Zhuo
notes: looking glass, ex-facebook VP turned author, composed tactician, visor-like glasses
title: Design Leader
bio: Went from intern to VP of design at Facebook across thirteen years, then wrote the book most new managers get handed. Now co-founding Sundial, and still obsessed with systems.

name: Katie Dill
notes: the pilot, stripe head of design, fast falcon-like checkout flow energy
title: Design Leader
bio: Head of Design at Stripe, from checkout flows to the Stripe Press hardcovers on your shelf. Previously Lyft, Airbnb and Frog. A licensed pilot, who says flying made her a better design leader.

name: Mery Kaftar
notes: drag handle, vercel design engineer, dashboard navigation, toolbelt with hooks
title: Design Engineer
bio: Design engineer at Vercel who redesigned the dashboard navigation everyone's been resizing since February. Previously at Hypermode and Clerk, building AI agent interfaces and onboarding flows developers actually finish.

name: Jhey Tompkins
notes: the showman, builds interfaces then explains them, electric demo energy, yellow accent
title: Design Engineer
bio: Builds interfaces and then explains them, which he'll tell you is the rarer skill. Now in Shopify's brand design studio, still producing the CSS demos that taught a good chunk of the industry what a browser can actually do.

name: Phi Hoang
notes: the figure-outer, perplexity creative studio, calm sing-like brand moment
title: Brand Designer
bio: Runs the creative studio at Perplexity and is a large part of why the brand got so much attention from designers. Calls himself a professional figure-outer, which is either very modest or exactly right.

name: Tobias van Schneider
notes: the gardener, mymind digital garden, psychic ness vibe, thoughtful founder
title: Brand Designer
bio: Building mymind, a private digital garden for everything you meant to remember. Previously art directed at Spotify, and has been quietly shaping how designers present themselves ever since.

name: Rob Hope
notes: above the fold, one page love archivist, surfer, egg-like single-page site capsule
title: Web Designer
bio: Runs One Page Love, a long-running archive of every good single-page site on the web, plus the Yo podcast. Surfs, ships, and stays an optimist about the internet, from South Africa.

name: dára sobaloju
notes: wildcard #1 beamer, heavy hitter, beam attacks, chunky streetwear
title: Wildcard
